items.exampleEn: We could hear trucks rumbling along the highway all night.
items.exampleZh: 我們整晚都聽得到卡車在公路上隆隆駛過。

items.exampleEn: She clenched the railing as the boat rocked from side to side.
items.exampleZh: 船左右搖晃時，她緊緊抓住欄杆。

items.exampleEn: Workers salvaged old bricks from the building before it was pulled down.
items.exampleZh: 工人在大樓拆除前，從裡面搶救出舊磚頭。

items.exampleEn: A stray cat has been sleeping in our garden all week.
items.exampleZh: 一隻流浪貓這整個星期都睡在我們的花園裡。

items.exampleEn: The suspect eluded the police by hiding in a crowded market.
items.exampleZh: 嫌犯躲進擁擠的市場，逃過了警方的追捕。
items.glossZh: 躲避；使難以達到或想起

items.exampleEn: The teenagers sprawled across the sofa, watching TV.
items.exampleZh: 青少年們攤開四肢躺在沙發上看電視。

items.exampleEn: My left eye has been twitching all day.
My leg went numb after I sat on the floor for an hour.
items.exampleZh: 我在地上坐了一個小時之後，腿就麻了。

items.sentenceEn: The speaker kept straying from the topic, and we soon lost interest.
items.sentenceZh: 講者一直偏離主題，我們很快就失去了興趣。

items.audioEn: In the middle of the meeting, my stomach began to rumble so loudly that everyone turned around.
items.audioZh: 會議進行到一半，我的肚子開始咕嚕咕嚕叫，大聲到大家都轉過頭來。
items.questionZh: 會議進行到一半時發生了什麼事？
options: The speaker's stomach made a loud noise.

items.sentenceEn: His name eludes me, but I remember his face clearly.
items.sentenceZh: 我想不起他的名字，但清楚記得他的長相。

items.sentenceEn: He clenched his teeth and pushed the heavy door open.
items.sentenceZh: 他咬緊牙關，把那扇沉重的門推開。

items.stemEn: Tom ____ his jaw as the referee walked away, but he said nothing.
items.stemZh: 裁判走開時，Tom 咬緊了牙關，但什麼也沒說。

items.stemEn: Her mouth ____ slightly, as if she were trying not to laugh.
items.stemZh: 她的嘴角微微抽動，好像在忍著不笑出來。

items.passageEn: On the last night of our camping trip, thunder began to rumble over the hills. My brother sprawled on his sleeping bag, too tired to move, while I tried to light the stove with fingers that were numb from the cold. Suddenly our dog strayed away from the tent and disappeared into the dark. We searched for an hour, but she eluded us every time we got close. At last we found her under a fallen tree, her ears twitching at every sound. The storm had damaged our tent badly, so the next morning we salvaged what we could, including two blankets and the stove, and walked back to the car.
items.passageZh: 露營之旅的最後一晚，雷聲開始在山丘上方隆隆作響。我哥哥累得不想動，攤開四肢躺在睡袋上；我則用凍到沒有知覺的手指，想辦法把爐子點著。突然，我們的狗離開帳篷走失了，消失在黑暗中。我們找了一個小時，但每次一靠近，牠就溜走。最後我們在一棵倒下的樹底下找到牠，牠的耳朵隨著每個聲響抽動。暴風雨把帳篷弄壞得很嚴重，所以隔天早上我們搶救出還能用的東西，包括兩條毯子和爐子，然後走回車上。

questions.questionZh: 他們最後在哪裡找到狗？
options: 山坡上一間空木屋裡面
隔壁營地的一頂帳篷裡

questions.questionZh: 第二天早上他們做了什麼？
options: 收拾還能用的東西，走回車上
打電話請朋友來接他們

items.promptZh: 我們設法從那次失敗的計畫裡挽救了一些好點子。
referenceEn: We managed to salvage some good ideas from the failed project.
We were able to salvage a few good ideas from that failed plan.
rubricZh: 「挽救、搶救」用 salvage，後面接救回的東西（例如 salvage some good ideas）
「設法」可寫，例如 managed to、were able to 等
「失敗的計畫」可寫，例如 the failed project、the failed plan 等

items.instructionZh: 用 stray 造一個句子，說說你做事或說話時偏離原本方向的經驗。
referenceEn: I sometimes stray from my shopping list when I see something on sale.
During the hike, I strayed from the path and got lost for a while.
rubricZh: stray 當動詞表示「偏離、走離」，常接 from（例如 stray from the path、stray from my list 等）
時態配合內容（例如 stray、strayed）
